patterns.name: Real-Time Push & Presence
patterns.summary: Maintain persistent or long-lived server connections to push state mutations with sub-second latency instead of wasteful short polling.
triggerSignals: Live chat, typing indicators, online presence
Real-time driver GPS tracking or live scoreboards
Streaming LLM token output
coreComponents: Pub-Sub Fan-Out Bus (Redis Pub/Sub or Kafka)
commonPitfalls: Storing connection maps only in local process memory without a shared session registry
Using full bidirectional WebSockets when unidirectional SSE works behind standard HTTP/2 proxies

patterns.name: High-Throughput Write Buffering & Ingestion
patterns.summary: Protect transactional or analytical stores from write spikes by absorbing events into partitioned logs and flushing sequentially in batches.
triggerSignals: Metrics, telemetry, audit logs, clickstreams
100k+ writes/sec with tolerable sub-second to few-second visibility lag
commonPitfalls: Synchronous row-by-row SQL inserts on hot request threads
Partitioning on a low-cardinality key causing one broker to saturate

patterns.name: Hybrid Fan-Out (Write vs Read)
patterns.summary: Pre-compute timelines in Redis for regular users on write, while merging celebrity posts on read to prevent N-million write amplification.
triggerSignals: Home timelines, activity streams, followed creator feeds
Extreme follower skew (average 200 vs celebrities with 50M+)
coreComponents: Celebrity Post Merge Layer + Social Graph Service
commonPitfalls: Pure fan-out-on-write causing minutes-long lag when a celebrity posts
Pure fan-out-on-read slamming follower DB joins on every feed open

patterns.name: Geo-Proximity & Dynamic Spatial Indexing
patterns.summary: Project 2D latitude/longitude coordinates onto 1D cell IDs (Geohash / Uber H3 / Quadtree) so nearest-neighbor lookups run in O(1)/O(log N) memory.
triggerSignals: Find nearby drivers, restaurants, or matches within R km
Moving entities updating coordinates every few seconds
coreComponents: In-Memory Geo Store (Redis GEO / Sharded Region Grid)
commonPitfalls: Running expensive SQL bounding-box trigonometric queries at high ping rates
Boundary edge misses without querying the 8 surrounding neighbor cells

patterns.name: Distributed Unique ID Generation (Snowflake)
patterns.summary: Generate globally unique, roughly time-sortable 64-bit IDs locally on worker nodes without cross-node coordination.
triggerSignals: Sharded databases needing B-Tree friendly primary keys
High-rate entity creation without a central auto-increment bottleneck
commonPitfalls: Using random UUIDv4 as a clustered primary key, causing severe B-Tree page splits
Ignoring backward NTP clock jumps that can emit duplicate IDs

patterns.name: Collision-Free Short Key Generation
patterns.summary: Generate compact URL/token keys via Base62 encoding over distributed counters or pre-generated Key Generation Service (KGS) batches.
triggerSignals: Short links, invite codes, tracking tokens
Zero-retry uniqueness requirement under concurrency
coreComponents: Base62 Encoder / KGS Pre-Allocated Key Pool
commonPitfalls: Hashing + naive DB retry loops under high write concurrency
Returning HTTP 301 permanently when analytics or link mutation is required

patterns.name: Transactional Double-Entry Ledger & Idempotency
patterns.summary: Guarantee zero lost or duplicated money using immutable debit/credit ledger rows, ACID transactions, and client-supplied idempotency keys.
triggerSignals: Payments, wallets, payouts, invoicing, billing
External bank/PSP network timeouts where retries are mandatory
commonPitfalls: Updating mutable 'balance' columns directly without an auditable immutable journal
Lacking idempotency keys on POST /charges during mobile network drops

patterns.name: Collaborative Real-Time State Convergence (OT / CRDT)
patterns.summary: Allow multiple users to edit shared state concurrently offline or online and converge deterministically without locking documents.
triggerSignals: Multi-cursor document editors, whiteboards, design canvases
Offline edits merging back upon reconnection
commonPitfalls: Last-write-wins overwriting concurrent edits silently
Unbounded CRDT tombstone memory growth without periodic snapshot compaction

patterns.name: Async Media Chunking, DAG Transcoding & Edge CDN
patterns.summary: Split large uploads into chunks, transcode multi-resolution segments in parallel via DAG workers, and serve HLS/DASH segments from edge CDNs.
triggerSignals: Video/audio streaming, large file uploads, image thumbnailing
Global viewer base with heterogeneous bandwidth
commonPitfalls: Proxying multi-GB video uploads through application API servers
Serving monolithic MP4s instead of adaptive bitrate (ABR) chunks

patterns.name: Flash-Sale Traffic Shaping & Atomic Inventory Hold
patterns.summary: Absorb extreme spike traffic in a virtual waiting room and enforce short-lived atomic seat/stock locks in memory before checkout.
triggerSignals: Concert tickets, limited product drops, flash deals
100k users competing for 500 inventory units within seconds
coreComponents: Edge Virtual Waiting Room / Queue Token
Redis Atomic Lua Hold with TTL
commonPitfalls: Letting all waiting users hit primary SQL row locks simultaneously
Forgetting TTL expiration cleanup when a user abandons checkout

patterns.name: Two-Stage Retrieval & Re-Ranking Funnel
patterns.summary: Combine fast parallel recall (inverted index + ANN vector search) over millions of items with a precision ML/cross-encoder re-ranker on top-K.
triggerSignals: Full-text search, e-commerce ranking, personalized recommendations
Sub-100ms latency budget across tens of millions of documents
commonPitfalls: Running heavy neural cross-encoders over the full corpus instead of top-100 candidates
Stale index sync lag between primary DB mutations and search shards

patterns.name: Production AI Gateway, Semantic Cache & Hybrid RAG
patterns.summary: Wrap probabilistic LLM inference with deterministic input/output guardrails, token-aware rate limits, semantic caching, ACL-scoped hybrid retrieval, and SLM fallbacks.
triggerSignals: Enterprise Q&A assistants, AI answer engines, high-cost LLM APIs
Strict latency (TTFT), permission safety, and GPU budget constraints
commonPitfalls: Retrieving private chunks first and filtering permissions post-LLM generation (data leak risk)
Rate-limiting only by RPM when single long-context prompts exhaust GPU KV-cache
